Apps live in their own repositories and reach AUGUR only through its published packages, the gateway, their manifest and events. This section will take you from the template to a released app, with one page for each thing an app can use: storage, events, the Inbox, notifications, background jobs and the model.

Until those pages are written, the guides in the repository cover them:

- [Build an app](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/build-an-app.md) and [Ship an app](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/ship-an-app.md)
- [App storage](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/app-storage.md), [Domain events](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/domain-events.md), [The Inbox](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/inbox.md), [Notifications](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/notifications.md)
- [Background and scheduled jobs](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/jobs.md), [Agents and models](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/agents.md), [Signed caller](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/signed-caller.md)
- [Previews of pull requests](https://github.com/harry-burton-dev/augur/blob/main/docs/app-previews.md)
